authority.l2_ruling: 2026-09-10: 采纳逃生门 ① —— 「R1 via x 序与 R2 lane 序同向」升为 R1 准入约束

constraints.x_order_rule: within a corridor, in R2 lane order, x must be monotone per polarity (direction fixed by W3 construction evidence; zero-crossing requirement)

no_allocation_scan.statement: No cross-page resource allocation emitted; per-page column-pair domains only.

supersedes.scope: R1 pair 域新增 x-序维；v1 的域定义/统计/见证全部继承不变

x_order_dim.field: pages[*].x_column_pairs = [[P_x, N_x, dist_max_mm], ...] (one realization witness per column pair is recoverable from the frozen verdict)
x_order_dim.semantics: per page: the set of feasible via-column pairs (P_x, N_x) that admit at least one candidate realization; x must be usable in a monotone per-polarity sequence across the corridor's lane order
